dedupe_keys.name: nus global streetscapes 10 million street level images across 688 cities with 346 features

description: NUS Global Streetscapes is an open dataset of 10 million street-level images covering 688 cities in 212 countries and regions, crowdsourced from Mapillary and KartaView and enriched by the Urban Analytics Lab at the National University of Singapore. Each image carries its original metadata plus geospatial, temporal, contextual, semantic and perceptual information, 346 features in all, such as road type, weather, season, settlement typology and pre-computed measures such as the green view index, labelled manually for a sample and then by trained models. The data are on Hugging Face (last updated February 2025) and a Baidu mirror, with code and a wiki on GitHub, and a 2024 journal paper by Hou and colleagues describes them. Coverage: 688 geographically balanced cities worldwide. Access: open download. Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0. Caveats: crowdsourced images are uneven in time and coverage within cities, and derived labels come from models. Simulation uses are street-level building and streetscape attributes, greenery and perception measures for urban heat, exposure and public space studies. Related records: Mapillary and KartaView street-level imagery.
